instruction: Put the red toy block on the orange tray.

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
red_block = obs["objects"]["red_block"]
orange_tray = obs["zones"]["orange_tray"]

# Check if orange_tray is occupied
occupied = False
for obj_name, obj in obs["objects"].items():
    if obj["center"][0] < orange_tray["center"][0] + orange_tray["half_size"][0] and \
       obj["center"][0] > orange_tray["center"][0] - orange_tray["half_size"][0] and \
       obj["center"][1] < orange_tray["center"][1] + orange_tray["half_size"][1] and \
       obj["center"][1] > orange_tray["center"][1] - orange_tray["half_size"][1] and \
       obj["top_z"] < orange_tray["center"][2] + 0.01:  # within tray height tolerance
        occupied = True
        break

if occupied:
    # Clear the tray using purple_box if available and unoccupied
    purple_box = obs["zones"]["purple_box"]
    purple_box_occupied = False
    for obj_name, obj in obs["objects"].items():
        if obj["center"][0] < purple_box["center"][0] + purple_box["half_size"][0] and \
           obj["center"][0] > purple_box["center"][0] - purple_box["half_size"][0] and \
           obj["center"][1] < purple_box["center"][1] + purple_box["half_size"][1] and \
           obj["center"][1] > purple_box["center"][1] - purple_box["half_size"][1] and \
           obj["top_z"] < purple_box["center"][2] + 0.01:
            purple_box_occupied = True
            break

    if not purple_box_occupied:
        # Move any object on orange_tray to purple_box
        for obj_name, obj in obs["objects"].items():
            if (abs(obj["center"][0] - orange_tray["center"][0]) < orange_tray["half_size"][0] + 0.01 and
                abs(obj["center"][1] - orange_tray["center"][1]) < orange_tray["half_size"][1] + 0.01 and
                obj["top_z"] < orange_tray["center"][2] + 0.01 and obj_name != "red_block"):
                # Pick and place on purple_box
                pick(obj_name, 0.02, obj["long_axis_yaw"])
                place("purple_box")
                break

# Now place red_block on orange_tray
pick("red_block", 0.02, red_block["long_axis_yaw"])
place("orange_tray")
